inspiration.observed_pattern: A CTE computes two partitioned ranks and a partition count, filtered CTE views identify the most and least expensive rows, and a self-join compares their quantities before joining descriptive metadata.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored depot stock imbalance report. Fixed inventory rows receive cost-direction ranks and per-depot counts, two filtered CTE views are joined to compare quantities, and a depot lookup supplies the final label; the source schema, names, values, and retail context are new.

fixture_notes: Depot 31 has at least three items and its cheapest item has four times the units of its costliest item, so it is reported. Depot 32 fails the minimum-count condition; depot 33 has enough items but its quantity comparison does not satisfy the imbalance predicate.
determinism_notes: Depot IDs, inventory IDs, prices, quantities, rank orderings, and final ordering are fixed. All quantities are positive; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE stock_depots (depot_id INT PRIMARY KEY, depot_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, region_name VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE depot_inventory (inventory_id INT PRIMARY KEY, depot_id INT NOT NULL, item_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, unit_cost DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, quantity INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH ranked_inventory AS (SELECT depot_id, item_label, unit_cost, quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY depot_id ORDER BY unit_cost DESC, quantity DESC) AS high_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY depot_id ORDER BY unit_cost, quantity DESC) AS low_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY depot_id) AS item_count FROM depot_inventory), costliest AS (SELECT * FROM ranked_inventory WHERE high_rank = 1 AND item_count >= 3), cheapest AS (SELECT * FROM ranked_inventory WHERE low_rank = 1) SELECT d.depot_id, d.depot_name, d.region_name, costliest.item_label AS costliest_item, cheapest.item_label AS cheapest_item, ROUND(cheapest.quantity / costliest.quantity, 2) AS quantity_ratio FROM costliest JOIN cheapest ON costliest.depot_id = cheapest.depot_id AND costliest.quantity < cheapest.quantity JOIN stock_depots AS d ON d.depot_id = costliest.depot_id ORDER BY quantity_ratio DESC, d.depot_id
